source_text: Revelatur ira Dei de caelo in omnem impietatem et iniustitiam hominum qui veritatem in iniustitia detinent. Propterea tradidit illos Deus in desideria cordis, in passiones ignominiae, in reprobum sensum. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: The wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and injustice of men who hold down the truth in injustice. Therefore God handed them over into the desires of the heart, into passions of shame, into a reprobate mind. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[The wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness >> Bible:Romans 1:18]] of those who [[suppress the truth in unrighteousness >> Bible:Romans 1:18]]. [[Therefore God gave them up >> Bible:Romans 1:24-28]] to desire, dishonor, and a debased mind. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Romans; do not copy Scheck FOTC
